Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

paweh 0.99.0

  • Initial development release.
  • Prepares CRAN-compatible vignette formatting and metadata, with package and background textbook citations.
  • Provides prospective power and minimum sample size calculations for case-control, TDT/family-based, quantitative-trait, sequencing-based, and LRTae study designs.
  • Supports selected forms of locus heterogeneity and genotype and phenotype misclassification.
  • Adds Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium diagnostics for observed genotypes, with exact and Pearson tests, plus asymptotic power and minimum sample size for specified genotype distributions and call-error scenarios.
  • Includes static visualization functions and an optional interactive Shiny dashboard.

Developed by Akil Anthony, Derek Gordon.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.1.
